name: agents-index.json
description: Index of .github/agents — canonical VS Code agent definitions

children.name: skf-general-orchestrator.agent.md
children.description: General-purpose orchestrator for the Spek-Fu AI framework. Analyzes requests, selects skills, and dispatches to the appropriate tier agent. Invoke me when you need the framework to handle a task end-to-end.

children.name: standard-agent.agent.md
children.description: Standard coding subagent backed by a capable model. Has no built-in workflow — invoke by passing a skill path and inputs in the prompt. The skill provides all logic.

children.name: large-context-agent.agent.md
children.description: Large-context subagent backed by a model with larger context window. Has no built-in workflow — invoke by passing a skill path and inputs in the prompt. The skill provides all logic.

children.name: fast-agent.agent.md
children.description: Fast coding subagent backed by a lightweight model. Has no built-in workflow — invoke by passing a skill path and inputs in the prompt. The skill provides all logic.
